The '''Institute for Computational and Experimental Research in Mathematics''' ('''ICERM'''), founded in 2011, is an American research institute in mathematics at [[Brown University]], funded since 2010 by a grant from the [[National Science Foundation]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=July 14, 2020|title=Brown's ICERM math institute awarded $23.7-million grant renewal|url=https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/800088|access-date=2021-12-27|website=EurekAlert!|publisher=American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)|language=en}}</ref>

== About ==
At the time of its founding, the institute was the eighth of its kind in the nation and the first in [[New England]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Long|first=Katherine|date=2011-03-08|title=Hopes high at math institute's debut|url=https://www.browndailyherald.com/2011/03/08/hopes-high-at-math-institutes-debut/|access-date=2021-05-19|website=Brown Daily Herald|language=en-US}}</ref> It is located in downtown [[Providence, Rhode Island]] in a building it shares with the [[Brown University School of Public Health]].<ref>{{citation|title= Institute for Computational and Experimental Research in Mathematics|first=Jill|last=Pipher|date=September 2013|pages=45–47|url=http://www.ems-ph.org/journals/newsletter/pdf/2013-09-89.pdf|journal=[[Newsletter of the European Mathematical Society]]|volume=89}}.</ref> 

The Institute for Computational and Experimental Research in Mathematics (ICERM), holds numerous events and workshops throughout the year. Workshops range from one day events all the way up to week-long conferences and conventions.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Burke|first=Lilah|date=June 24, 2020|title=Mathematicians urge cutting ties with police|url=https://www.insidehighered.com/news/2020/06/24/mathematicians-urge-cutting-ties-police|access-date=2021-12-27|website=insidehighered.com|language=en}}</ref> A notable ICERM workshop was, "Illustrating Mathematics" (2016), which brought mathematicians and digital artist together.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Farris|first=Frank A.|title=With new technology, mathematicians turn numbers into art|url=http://theconversation.com/with-new-technology-mathematicians-turn-numbers-into-art-61254|access-date=2021-12-27|website=The Conversation|date=5 April 2017 |language=en}}</ref>

==Directors of ICERM==

* [[Brendan Hassett]] (2016–present)
